2609.34392.title: Org-Agent: Beyond Personal Assistants Towards Organizational Agents
2609.34392.paper_summary: Language model agents serving organizations must coordinate requests from multiple users while using knowledge distributed across their interactions. We identify two complementary capabilities for this setting, namely cross-user interaction and decision-making, as well as cross-user memory and knowledge use. Both capabilities are governed by organizational constraints across three aspects: user identity, authority, and access permissions; the attribution and temporal validity of information; and rules for resolving conflicting requirements across users and completion requirements for joint decisions. These constraints shape what information or decisions must be obtained before an action can proceed and what conditions must be satisfied during its execution. Motivated by this, we introduce Org-Agent, a unified constraint-centric reasoning framework that organizes task execution in three stages. Specifically, Org-Agent decomposes a task into atomic subtasks and constructs a task dependency graph whose edges encode the dependencies among them. Building on this graph, it schedules the subtasks in dependency order through topological sorting. It then executes each subtask while accounting for the task's constraints, supported by evidence-acquisition and memory-management tools. Experiments on MUSES-Bench and GroupMemBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Org-Agent on both capabilities, and ablations further support the contributions of dependency modeling and tool use.
2609.34392.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型代理服務於組織時，必須協調來自多個用戶的請求，同時利用其互動中分散的知識。我們為這種情境確定了兩種互補的能力，即跨用戶互動和決策，以及跨用戶記憶和知識使用。這兩種能力受到三個方面的組織約束的影響：用戶身份、權限和訪問許可；信息的歸屬和時間有效性；以及解決用戶之間衝突需求和聯合決策完成要求的規則。這些約束塑造了在行動進行之前必須獲得哪些信息或決策，以及在執行過程中必須滿足哪些條件。基於此，我們介紹了Org-Agent，一個統一的以約束為中心的推理框架，將任務執行組織為三個階段。具體而言，Org-Agent將任務分解為原子子任務，並構建一個任務依賴圖，其邊緣編碼了它們之間的依賴關係。在此圖的基礎上，它通過拓撲排序按依賴順序調度子任務。然後，它在考慮任務約束的情況下執行每個子任務，並得到證據獲取和記憶管理工具的支持。在MUSES-Bench和GroupMemBench上的實驗展示了Org-Agent在這兩種能力上的有效性，而消融實驗進一步支持了依賴建模和工具使用的貢獻。
